audit.whatIsWrong: Four chart rows read Skill or Illaoi where the page's own prose and the packet both name a clear owner.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Sylas, Illaoi, Illaoi, Illaoi, Illaoi, Illaoi, Sylas at 55.83% over 2549 games. On disk row 0 read Skill while whys[0] and early both say Sylas edges level 1; rows 3 and 4 read Skill while whys[3] ('keep your all-in damage above his Q-poke-and-heal pattern'), whys[4] and mid ('Levels 2 through first-item are yours') give them to Illaoi; row 6 read Illaoi while whys[6] and the late block say Sylas's Hijack and roams overtake you.
audit.corrected: Rows 0 and 6 to Sylas, rows 3 and 4 to Illaoi, in both layers as one atomic group with ratings to match. EVEN 6/10 kept — the lane really is Illaoi's middle and Sylas's edges.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike tells you to 'force the all-in before he can Hijack' without saying how often Hijack comes back.
audit.why: Hijack is 80/55/30s at 950 range; Leap of Faith is 120/95/70s. His ultimate is on a shorter cooldown than yours at every rank, so 'before he can Hijack' is not a window that opens by waiting — it only exists inside a single fight, and if you trade ultimates you lose the exchange on cooldown. That number changes how a player plans the level-6 all-in.
audit.corrected: 80s vs 120s written into spikes[1] and the cooldown block.

audit.whatIsWrong: Abscond / Abduct is described in four places as 'His dash + stun (recast pull)'.
audit.why: Riot on the ability (E, 13/12/11/10/9s, 400 range): 'Sylas dashes to a location. Sylas can recast the ability to throw his chains out, pulling himself to an enemy he hits.' There is no stun in it — the recast pulls Sylas to you, it does not lock you down. The kit's derived flags list only dash and projectile, no hardCC. A player told to expect a stun will hold Test of Spirit for CC that never comes and give up the 13-second window that actually follows the dash. Second missed detail: Chain Lash (Q, 10/9/8/7/6s) damages and slows on impact, then 'after a delay, magical energy explodes from the intersection point' — the second hit is dodgeable by stepping off the cross.
audit.corrected: The stun claim removed from dosFull[0], report[5] and the cooldown block, replaced with the real dash-and-pull plus its 13s; Chain Lash's delayed detonation written into report[5].

audit.whatIsWrong: Every cooldown reference on the page is the phrase 'Abscond / Abduct's cooldown' with no number.
audit.why: Abscond / Abduct 13/12/11/10/9s, Chain Lash 10/9/8/7/6s, Kingslayer 12/10.5/9/7.5/6s, Hijack 80/55/30s — against Harsh Lesson at 4s and Test of Spirit at 16s. A spent dash at rank 1 buys thirteen seconds, which is most of a Test of Spirit cycle and the concrete version of the advice.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written into dosFull[0], report[5] and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Executioner's Calling early — his healing fights your pattern' does not say what heals him.
audit.why: Kingslayer (W, 12/10.5/9/7.5/6s, 400 range) 'lunges at an enemy with magical force dealing damage and healing himself against enemy champions' — the heal only happens off champions, and at rank 5 it is a 6-second cooldown inside the extended trades this page tells you to take. That is the interaction flagged in _missing (needs-antiheal) and it makes the anti-heal a laning purchase rather than a late one.
audit.corrected: Kingslayer named as the heal in report[8] and the cooldown block.

edits.before: Beware — Sylas's R Hijack can steal your R Leap of Faith, but your own tentacle wall still out-slams him if you ult first in a committed fight; force the all-in before he can Hijack, and every tentacle detonates on him.
edits.after: Beware — Sylas's R Hijack can steal your R Leap of Faith, and at 80 seconds it comes back faster than your 120, so force the all-in before he can take it and your own tentacle wall detonates on him first.

edits.before: His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Abscond is a 13s dash and the recast pulls him in — it does not stun, so fight after he spends it.

edits.before: Track Sylas's Abscond / Abduct: His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. When it is down — Land E, slam the spirit.
edits.after: Abscond (13s) is a dash with a chain-pull recast, not a stun; Chain Lash detonates a beat later, so step off the cross.

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct (13s at rank 1): a dash with a chain-pull recast — no stun anywhere in it. - Kingslayer 12s heals him off you. - Hijack 80s at rank 1, faster than your 120s R. - Leap of Faith: kill windows.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Core: Iceborn Gauntlet  (the slow makes tentacles land), then Sterak's Gage; boots Mercury's Treads. Executioner's Calling early — his healing fights your pattern.
edits.after: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Core: Iceborn Gauntlet  (the slow makes tentacles land), then Sterak's Gage; boots Mercury's Treads. Executioner's Calling early — Kingslayer heals him off you.

notes: The 'dash + stun' description of Abscond / Abduct appeared four times and is the kind of error that changes how a player holds Test of Spirit — Riot's text has no CC in that ability at all. Left alone as champion-level issues: the loading line and focus.text still read 'Sylas Abscond / Abduct' with the same phrasing, which is correct as a tracked ability even though the stun wording is gone from the descriptions. Standing Illaoi flag misfires unwritten as elsewhere: Leap of Faith does not ground or grant untargetability, Test of Spirit does not slow.
